summary: test_stateful can expose real preset surfaces on both ABIs (VST3 unit/program interfaces split across component/controller; CLAP preset-discovery + preset-load extensions) reusing the existing RFST state codec, and spawn/pre-Hello faults can be injected child-side via l1-runner argv without touching run()'s no-argv contract
Survey vendored vst3 0.3.0 bindings and clack-extensions feature flags to fix interface/extension placement

VST3 preset interfaces split by side: controller owns IUnitInfo/IUnitHandler/IUnitHandler2, component owns IProgramListData/IUnitData; preset selection must write back into the shared live gain cell using the same RFST codec as state

CLAP preset-discovery is a factory-level extension requiring the clack-extensions preset-discovery feature; state-context is unnecessary because preset load reuses the existing clap.ext.state blob; coordinator approved preset-discovery with state-context optional

run() accepts no argv under wire v2; both bridges defer ABI plugin creation to Initialize, so plugin-level create rejection surfaces as Initialize -> PluginFailed rather than at Instantiate or a dormant wire CreateInstance verb

Implement spawn faults in the existing l1-runner bins via --ruviform-test-fault=MODE consumed after fixture load and before run(), instead of dedicated fault bins: preserves run()'s no-argv contract, stays fail-closed on unrecognized argv, gives identical pre-Hello reachability, and keeps fixture resolution single-sourced; recorded in ADR issue-630-test-spawn-fault-runner-argv

InstanceLimit probe unreachable: Bundled isolation spawns additional children when one fills to the 64-mint registry bound, and Dedicated isolation gives each instance its own child; probe test removed as testing an unreachable host behavior

Fast pre-Hello death classifies nondeterministically across Transport/ExitObserved/Internal depending on pipe EOF vs exit observation vs channel teardown ordering; handshake-phase death is not fixture-injectable because Scan/CreateInstance handlers run no plugin code

Adopt PRE_HELLO_DEATH = {Transport, ExitObserved, Internal} oracle for pre-Hello death tests while keeping Handshake and Timeout strictly pinned; document mid-handshake death and InstanceLimit as unsupported/unreachable boundaries in evidence

All green: unit tests 91 (VST3) + 66 (CLAP), mise run test-l1-real-plugin all lanes pass including 16+16 spawn-fault e2e, test-rt pass, prek pass; committed c38f2b0c and pushed; PR #735 opened with Refs #630
